analysis.title: GS Blekos - Midterms First take Europe Strategy Off BS Liabilities Bayer Aramco Gecina Zalando RWE Philips Banks Monitor 4 Nov 2026
key_insights: GS raises STOXX 600 EPS growth forecasts to 18% for 2026 and 7% for 2027, and introduces a 2028 forecast of 5%. The upgrade comes from an updated earnings framework with strong contributions from Financials and Commodities.

GS economists expect nominal Euro-area GDP growth of 3.3% in 2026 and 2.8% in 2027, well below the pace of European earnings growth. GS attributes the gap to the sector composition and global exposure of the listed market.

Hyperscalers have issued $271 billion of debt so far in 2026, above GS's full-year 2026 forecast of $250 billion. More than $40 billion of deals were announced since October 29th, and hyperscaler free cash flow has turned negative.

GS says some of the recent hyperscaler issuance is a pull-forward of planned 2027 supply. It sees scope for more issuance, but expects capital markets access to be uneven across issuers and dependent on market tone.
GS estimates $657 billion of year-to-date global AI-related debt issuance across syndicated credit markets through November 2nd, far larger than the five hyperscalers alone.

Bayer stays Buy on a potentially imminent court ruling on the glyphosate settlement and on Pharma growth that GS thinks the market under-appreciates. GS raises its Nubeqa forecasts, and Crop remains volatile near term.
Saudi Aramco stays Buy after a 3Q26 net income beat and strong cash flow generation. The stock trades at a 12% discount to its 5Y average P/E, and the SAR34 target implies about 30% upside.

Gecina is downgraded to Neutral from Buy because pipeline lettings are slower than expected. GS cuts 2026-30E EPS by 0% to 8%, lowers rental reversion, removes buyback assumptions and treats 2027 as a transition year.
Zalando GMV growth improved sequentially, supported by 3P and ZMS. The Zalando Extended announcement is an incremental positive, and the target stays at €44.
RWE: the gas plants auction brings upside to GS's base case.
Philips reported strong Q3 orders and resilient margins. GS names D&T growth as the next key unlock.

The note links a first take on the US midterm elections (4 Nov 2026, 8AM NY) and a European banks deposit and lending volume and pricing monitor for September 2026. The text gives no content for either.

market_movers.rationale: The potential imminent glyphosate settlement ruling could remove the litigation overhang, and Pharma is entering a new growth phase. The target rises 4% from €63.5 after higher Nubeqa forecasts and a rolled-forward DCF and SOTP.
3Q26 net income beat and strong cash flow generation. The stock trades at a 12% discount to its 5Y average P/E, and the target implies about 30% upside.
Pipeline lettings are slower than expected. The target falls about 10% from €80.4 and implies about 11% upside versus 9% average for GS coverage.
GMV growth improved sequentially on 3P and ZMS, and the Zalando Extended announcement is an incremental positive. The target is unchanged.
The gas plants auction brings upside to GS's base case.
Q3 orders were strong and margins resilient. D&T growth is the next key unlock.

sector_views.rationale: Financials are named as a strong contributor to the upgraded STOXX 600 EPS forecasts.
Commodities are named as a strong contributor to the upgraded STOXX 600 EPS forecasts.

earnings_insights: STOXX 600 EPS growth forecast (GS estimate): 18% for 2026, 7% for 2027, 5% for 2028.
Saudi Aramco 3Q26 reported net income beat, with strong cash flow generation. GS EPS estimate changes are +0.4%/+0.0%/+0.0% for 2026/27/28.
Gecina GS 2027E/28E EPS estimates are about 3%/4% below Visible Alpha consensus. GS forecasts a 1% 4Y EPS CAGR, with 27E/26E EPS down 4% on company guidance of 2027 as a transition year.
Zalando GMV growth improved sequentially in the latest quarter, supported by 3P and ZMS.
Philips reported Q3 orders as strong and margins as resilient.

macro_indicators.interpretation: GS economists' forecast is well below the 18% STOXX 600 EPS growth forecast.
The forecast is well below the 7% STOXX 600 EPS growth forecast for 2027.

risk_factors: Capital markets access for AI-related debt issuance may be uneven across issuers and dependent on market tone.
Crop remains volatile near term for Bayer.
Gecina faces longer lead times to let pipeline projects, lower rental reversion, and 2027 as a transition year.
